title: ResourceScrubbed
description:
`resource_scrubbed` — the field scrub (field-grain scrub spec S1, S4): every prior value of a
resource's title, origin URI or one property family (or every family's prior history) redacted
from the ledger and the projection, on a resource that survives. With `cleared`, today's value
was cleared too, by ordinary events appended before this one in the act's transaction.

Keyed `subject_table` (`kb_resources`) / `subject_id`, never `resource_id`, and the family by
`field.family`, never `event_id` (the D1 join-key rule). It never carries a top-level `owner`:
`_resource_erasure_trail_scope` joins on `payload->'owner'->>'id'`. Paths only, never values or
key text: the record of a redaction must not carry what was redacted.

cleared.description: True when the act also cleared today's value. Absent means today's value was kept.

field.description: The field scrubbed, and the property family's handle when the field is one family.

redacted_fields.description: The ledger paths this act redacted to their sentinels, in the shape `resource_erased` uses.

AnchorTable.description: A polymorphic anchor/endpoint reference. Serializes table names exactly as the DDL spells them.

RedactedEventFields.description:
The ledger paths of one event: redacted (`redacted_fields`) or named-and-unreached
(`ledger_remainder`). ONE shape for both, so the cut-2 completion pass derives what it redacts
from what cut 1 recorded without translating (resource erasure spec D12). The event is keyed
`event`, never `event_id` — no trail join-key shape rides an admin payload (D1). Paths only,
never values: the record of a redaction must not carry what was redacted.

paths.description: JSON paths within that event's `payload` (or `metadata`), e.g. `title`, `origin_uri`.

ScrubFieldKind.description:
The field a field scrub names. A field, never a value: no request or record carries the text
being scrubbed.

oneOf.description: One resource-owned property family, named by its handle.
Every resource-owned property family's prior history. Never cleared.

ScrubbedField.description:
The field a field scrub acted on. `family` is the handle of a property family: the id of the
first event that still carries the family's key text on the resource. It is present only for
[`ScrubFieldKind::Property`]. Keyed `family`, never `event_id`: no trail join-key shape rides
an admin payload (resource erasure D1).
